title: Thresholding Scheme for the Half-Harmonic Map Heat Flow
summary: We propose a thresholding scheme for the half-harmonic map heat flow from the flat torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ into the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^m$ in $\mathbb{R}^{m+1}$, whose iterates are given by convolution with the Poisson kernel, replacing the Gaussian kernel of the classical Merriman-Bence-Osher algorithm, and pointwise normalization. We prove that the piecewise constant interpolants subconverge to a weak solution of the half-harmonic maps heat flow that attains the initial map strongly in the energy space and satisfies the energy-dissipation inequality.
